title: Coverage, server health, profiles and the debugger reach the editor through its own APIs and open formats — `FileCoverage`, `LanguageStatusItem`, DAP's UI, speedscope — and the extension builds none of them
divergesFromPhp: Xdebug's profiler writes cachegrind for KCachegrind or PhpStorm's own viewer; a Novis profile is speedscope JSON and opens in speedscope.app or an embedded view of it
